submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.122%) at Sb fraction 0.389. EQE rises steeply from Sb 0.18 (0.010%) to 0.32 (0.097%) and 0.39 (0.122%), then collapses at the Sb-rich end (0.66: 0.0018%, 0.79: 0.0038%). XRD at 0.25, 0.32 and 0.42 shows the same phase assemblage, so the optimum is set by composition within that single-phase region. The peak is likely around Sb 0.39–0.45.

rejected.reason: Near NiSb2O6 stoichiometry, but EQE is only 0.0018%
